tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, card borders, primary buttons, selected nav item, focus ring. The one strong colour; everything else is a grey step away from it.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and card background. Text on ink-filled elements (primary buttons, active steps).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: note boxes, selected choice cards, hover on nav items, bar tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside cards and lists. Decorative only, never the border of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of unselected controls such as choice cards (3:1 against paper).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy that supports a heading, descriptions, field labels, dt in data lists.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text: roles, timestamps, hints, overlines. Passes 4.5:1 on paper and surface-muted.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Background of disabled buttons.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Label of disabled buttons, on disabled-bg.

tokens.name: panel-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted panels: top bar, system view / history log, the payout figure.

tokens.name: panel-inverse-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panel-inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on panel-inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Meta text on panel-inverse: timestamps, status lines, secondary nav text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the page title on overview and landing screens.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Object titles: a claim, a policy, a customer.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Main panel title, the current step.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key amounts: payout, premium before and after.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Six steps through the whole life of a policy.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Policy creates a new version that applies from the change date.
styles.usage: Default text, inputs, data list values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, values in data lists, nav item labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, hints, notes under values.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels above lists and panels. Always uppercase (text-transform).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API calls, ids, dates in ISO format, diagnosis codes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside nav groups, between icon and tiny text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in choice lists, label-to-field inside dense rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields, card body padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of panels and the side nav.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards and columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding, top bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above the page title.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space at the end of a page.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bar tracks and hatch bars; a fully square variant of the system.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and id chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, inputs, cards, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Softer variant for customer-facing screens; swap for radius-md everywhere, never mix.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Step dots, avatars, count pills.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any clickable control (touch target).

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs and selects in forms.

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action buttons (Apply change, Approve payout).

tokens.name: size-step-dot
tokens.usage: Step indicator circles.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every card, input and divider.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The one card that holds the decision on a page; selected choice cards; focus ring.
